skill.name: video-extend
skill.description: Extend an existing video clip through the RunComfy CLI using Google Veo 3.1 Extend or Fast Extend. The skill helps choose an endpoint, write a continuation prompt, and save the generated clip.

content.value_statement: Short clips often end before the story beat is complete. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to extend a clip through RunComfy.
actual_capabilities: Runs RunComfy extend-video or fast extend-video endpoints through the CLI.
Accepts a source video URL and a text prompt for the next action.
Helps choose full Extend for quality or Fast Extend for lower-cost drafts.
Supports chained extensions by reusing the previous output as the next input.
Summarizes exit codes and troubleshooting paths for failed RunComfy jobs.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and a valid RunComfy account or token.
Only extends existing clips; it does not generate a first clip from scratch.
Results depend on the source video, prompt clarity, and upstream model behavior.
Long chains can accumulate identity drift and motion changes.

use_cases.title: Extend a hero shot
use_cases.description: Continue an approved product or character clip without rebuilding the full scene.

use_cases.title: Draft chained story beats
use_cases.description: Build a longer narrative by extending one short clip through several planned actions.

use_cases.title: Create lower-cost motion variants
use_cases.description: Use Fast Extend for rough versions before selecting a final full-quality extension.

prompt_templates.title: Basic continuation
prompt_templates.prompt: Extend this video using the default RunComfy extend endpoint. Source video: [URL]. Next action: [short action]. Save the result in ./out.

prompt_templates.title: Choose quality mode
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my goal and choose Extend or Fast Extend. Source video: [URL]. Goal: [quality, speed, or budget]. Continuation prompt: [prompt].

prompt_templates.title: Plan a short chain
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a three-beat extension plan for this clip. Source video: [URL]. Keep each beat simple, then run the first extension.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced production sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Design and execute a chained RunComfy video extension workflow. Use Fast Extend for drafts, full Extend for final outputs, and track each output path.

output_examples.input: Extend this city shot so the camera keeps moving toward the entrance.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Veo 3.1 Extend, writes a continuation prompt, and returns the saved clip path after RunComfy finishes.

output_examples.input: Make three more beats from this character clip for a short product story.
output_examples.output: The skill breaks the request into simple beats, extends the first clip, and prepares the next prompt from the output.

output_examples.input: I need a cheaper draft before the final render.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends Fast Extend for drafting, then full Extend when the motion and story beat are approved.

best_practices: Use one clear motion beat per extension.
Keep the camera direction explicit, such as static, push in, or dolly out.
Use user-provided video URLs only and keep tokens out of prompts and logs.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a new first clip; use an image-to-video or text-to-video skill instead.
Do not chain many long extensions without checking for identity drift.
Do not paste API tokens into the prompt or the RunComfy input.

faq.question: Does this create a video from text only?
faq.answer: No. It extends an existing video URL. Use a generation skill to create the first clip.

faq.question: Which model does it use?
faq.answer: It targets Google Veo 3.1 Extend and Fast Extend through RunComfy.

faq.question: Can it make a long video?
faq.answer: It can chain several extensions. Review each output because drift can grow across many generations.

faq.question: Does it need network access?
faq.answer: Yes. The RunComfy CLI sends the job to RunComfy and downloads the generated video.

faq.question: Where are results saved?
faq.answer: The RunComfy command saves generated clips in the selected output directory.

faq.question: Is my token handled by the skill?
faq.answer: The skill tells users to use RunComfy login or RUNCOMFY_TOKEN. It warns against logging tokens.
